page_title: LEV 0-0 UNI | Bayer Leverkusen v Union Berlin 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+7' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) lines up the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but he produces a poor shot that goes high over the bar. The ball could have snow on it when it returns!
90+6' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+6' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick.
90+4' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+2' Bayer Leverkusen are ruled offside.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
88' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
87' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
86' Substitution. Exequiel Palacios will be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
85' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
84' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to send the ball in.

84' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
83' David Preu (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

83' David Preu (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
82' Substitution. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) replaces Josip Juranovic.
81' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
78' The attendance is 30000.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with David Preu (Union Berlin) coming on for Janik Haberer.
78' Here is a change. Christopher Trimmel is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
76' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle after Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
76' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) is replacing Edmond Tapsoba.
74' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Alejandro Grimaldo.

73' It looks like Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Bastian Dankert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen in a dangerous position.
72' A clever lofted pass finds Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) in space inside the box. He looks up and hits a precise shot towards goal, but Lukas Hradecky is equal to it and makes an easy save.
71' A player from Bayer Leverkusen pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
68' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
67' One of the players from Union Berlin times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
66' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Lukas Hradecky is equal to it.
66' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
65' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an injury.
63' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
63' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
62' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

62' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
61' Today's match ends for Andrej Ilic who will be replaced by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin).
60' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Tim Skarke and he is replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
59' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
58' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Aleix Garcia.
56' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
55' Piero Hincapie crosses and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
53' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow was alert and made a comfortable save.
52' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and it's Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.
50' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' A player from Union Berlin takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
46' Substitution. Nathan Tella leaves the pitch and is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

45+1' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
45+1' A player from Union Berlin brings down an opponent and commits a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
45' The resulting corner, taken by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), comes to nothing.

44' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
42' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Chance! Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
39' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.
38' The foul by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Bastian Dankert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
37' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is able to continue to play.
35' The game is interrupted now, Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.

30' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
27' The free kick is delivered by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
24' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
22' One of the Union Berlin players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
19' None of the Union Berlin players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
17' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
14' Union Berlin have a goal ruled out for offside!
14' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is about to take a corner kick.

13' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.

11' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
7' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
7' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Bastian Dankert.
